records.permissions: provider-declared Public Domain (USA-qualified); territorial display gate unresolved

reasons: Provider title/ID, the separate inventory entries for ita1927 and ita1885, and an exact Genesis 1:1 comparison resolve this archive as Riveduta 1927. The DO885 abbreviation and Diodati 1885 boilerplate line remain recorded metadata conflicts; no translator is attributed because the reviewed provider page does not name one.

The pinned archive contains 66 ordered books, 1,189 chapters and 31,102 unique references. XML/TXT references match in order after 11 VPL-to-SIL book-code aliases; all text differences are trailing ASCII padding in XML, and unchanged TXT wording is the proposed display text.

The provider inventory qualifies its public-domain list as U.S.-only to the best of its knowledge. The current static reader does not enforce a country-limited display grant, so keep this source uninstalled until broader rights evidence or a real territory-aware serving/display gate exists.
